info.name: Snowstorm hands-on (api-test.mysnomed.com)
info.description: Hands-on requests for the Snowstorm developer workshop. Select the environment 'api-test.mysnomed.com', put the password you were given in its Current value, then send requests one at a time. The whole room shares one public IP and the server rate-limits per IP: do not use the Collection Runner.

exec: // FHIR endpoints only: the native API answers 500 to a FHIR Accept header.

item.name: 0 · Check you are connected
item.description: Run these first. A 401 means the environment is not selected or the password is missing.

request.description: Native API. Expect Snowstorm 10.12.2.
SNOMEDCT (International) and SNOMEDCT-LOINCEXT (LOINC extension).
Every CodeSystem the FHIR API knows: two SNOMED editions plus the KKM facility CodeSystem.

item.name: 1 · Look up a code ($lookup)
item.description: What does a code mean? Display, version, properties.

request.description: Read display, version and the inactive flag. The display is US English by default.

exec: const p = pm.response.json().parameter.find(x => x.name === 'display'); pm.test('display returned', () => pm.expect(p).to.exist);

request.description: displayLanguage=en-GB gives 'Paracetamol 500 mg oral tablet'. Prefer it to the Accept-Language header on this server: the gateway cache does not key on that header.
Each parent comes back as a property with code 'parent'.

item.name: 2 · Search inside a value set ($expand)
item.description: Type-ahead search, counting, ECL. ECL goes in the url parameter, URL-encoded.

request.description: << means descendants or self. Postman encodes it for you; in curl or a hand-built URL write %3C%3C. count sets the page size.
Our gateway blanks SNOMED filters shorter than 3 characters: an empty 200, not an error.
Read expansion.total. Use count=1, not 0: count=0 is a 500 on Snowstorm 10.12.2.

item.name: 2.4 ECL refinement: has active ingredient paracetamol

request.description: < 763158003 |Medicinal product| : 127489000 |Has active ingredient| = 387517004 |Paracetamol|. The |terms| are comments: Snowstorm does not check them against the codes.
isa/<code> is the FHIR shorthand for << <code>, with nothing to encode.
offset must be a multiple of count.

item.name: 3 · Is this code allowed here? ($validate-code)
item.description: What a form or an API checks before saving a code.

item.name: 3.1 A clinical drug in the medicinal product value set

request.description: result = true.

item.name: 3.2 A substance in the same value set

request.description: result = false, with a message.

item.name: 4 · Inactive codes and their replacements
item.description: Every release inactivates codes that records already hold.

request.description: Alprazolam 0.25mg tablet: inactive = true.

item.name: 4.2 Find what replaced it ($translate, SAME AS)

request.description: 900000000000527005 is the SAME AS association reference set. Expect 321241004.
200 with total 0, not an error. This is why value sets need a minimum-size check after each release.

item.name: 5 · Local content: KKM health facilities
item.description: A non-SNOMED CodeSystem and stored ValueSets served from the same FHIR API.

item.name: 5.1 Find the stored value sets by name

request.description: Name search is a prefix match on the ValueSet name.
Facility filters work from 2 letters.
Properties: state, district, type, sector.

exec: const p = pm.response.json().parameter.find(x => x.name === 'display'); pm.test('display returned', () => pm.expect(p).to.exist);

item.name: 6 · The native SNOMED API
item.description: What the SNOMED CT browser uses. Richer, but specific to Snowstorm: prefer FHIR in applications.

request.description: Returns fsn and pt for each match.
Descriptions, relationships (the drug model: ingredient, strength, dose form) in one call.
Same ECL, native response: read total.

item.name: 7 · Pitfalls (deliberately wrong)
item.description: Each of these fails quietly or loudly. Know the symptom.

request.description: Returns all 385, not 5. Use count.
HAPI-0389 / by zero on Snowstorm 10.12.2. Use count=1 and read total.
Node's fetch sends this header by default. Snowstorm answers 500; send en or en-GB instead.

item.name: 8 · Pharmacy examples
item.description: For pharmacists and prescribing screens. Clinical drugs (CD) are the products a prescriber picks: in the International drug model they are the products with a 762949000 |Has precise active ingredient|. displayLanguage=en-GB gives British names (paracetamol, not acetaminophen).

request.description: Clinical drugs only (no 'amlodipine-containing product' groupers). Expect 79.
Includes the co-amoxiclav combinations. Expect 30.
Two refinements joined by a comma mean AND. Expect 94, single and combination products.

item.name: 8.4 The salt trap: warfarin clinical drugs by base substance

request.description: 0 results. Clinical drugs record the precise ingredient, which is the salt: warfarin SODIUM. A silent empty answer, not an error.

item.name: 8.5 The fix: include salts with 'Is modification of'

request.description: Warfarin itself OR any substance that is a modification of warfarin. Expect 11.

item.name: 9 · Clinical examples: diagnosis, findings, procedures
item.description: For clinical forms: diagnosis and problem lists, symptoms, procedures, body sites, observations, and the SNOMED to ICD-10 map used for morbidity reporting.

request.description: Word-prefix matching in any order. Expect 134.
Clinical finding includes symptoms and signs as well as disorders. Expect 38.
38341003 |Hypertensive disorder| in the Disease value set: true.

item.name: 9.4 Is chest pain a valid diagnosis?

request.description: 29857009 |Chest pain| is a finding, not a disease: false. Decide per field which hierarchy you allow.
